title: Apexspace
description: Aerospace-industrial dark: charcoal (#1a1a1a) and pure-black bands, white text, mid-grey links, one signal yellow for buttons and a set of bus tones (purple, blue, orange, green) for product accents. Light uppercase Space Grotesk headings, 12px uppercase Space Mono labels and Inter body; square corners, 1px white-15% hairlines, a 16px gutter edge to edge. Light sibling: a paper-grey page with white cards and the same yellow.
notes: Space Grotesk, Space Mono and Inter are the original's own (open-licence) faces
background is the charcoal band; card is the pure-black band (platform cards, customer tiles, black buttons)
chart-1…chart-4 are the product tones (purple, blue, orange, green) used for per-product accents
muted is a lifted grey so media placeholders read on both charcoal and black
--radius is 0 and --page-gutter 1rem at every width; --section-y is fluid 5rem → 10rem
name: apexspace-theme
